notes: pen takes both that and not as one discontinuous rendering, since no negative morpheme stands in the clause for the not to answer to (rules 25 and 30).
ye stands before the vocative noun rather than after an imperative, so it is the vocative's under rule 36; the imperatives keep only their own words.
yourselves in quit yourselves denotes the very participant the verb's person and number denote, so it belongs to the verb's unit and is not a supplied object (rule 44).
